content.content: 1. Necessity per prerequisite: separation needs the backend for one change owning one node and versioning all state, the document shape for carrying depends_on and evaluates, the relations for naming depends_on and evaluates, and validity for the machine-checkable definition — each edge carries independent weight. Fail if any edge can be dropped without loss; name the dropped edge. 2. License: no element contradicts any prerequisite. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: Separation is where VCS stops and graph begins; the gate forces each clause to answer to its prerequisite.
